newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST-Astra Q1 profit seen 14 pct up.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Astra Q1 profit seen 14 pct up.

text.p: Swedish drugs company Astra was expected to post a pre-tax profit of 3.93 billion crowns for the first quarter of 1997, a Reuters poll of 15 analysts showed on Friday.
This would be an increase of 14 percent on the same period a year ago.
For the full year Astra's profit was expected to reach 15.68 billion crowns compared to 13.22 billion crowns in 1996.
The forecast was 1997 was two percent higher than when Reuters conducted its last survey on Astra's results before the release of the 1996 figures.

Analysts interviewed for the poll were from Aros, Carnegie, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Dresdner Kleinwort Benson, Enskilda, Fiba, Fischer, Hagstromer & Qviberg, Handelsbanken, HSBC Midland, Matteus, Myrberg & Wiklund, SBC Warburg, Swedbank, and Ohman.
Astra will release its first quarter earnings on April 21.
